decisions.reason: GA4 remains the mandatory Google Analytics standard, so shop clients keep needing the tracking plugin and it supports the firm's analytics services.
Universal Analytics was fully shut down by Google in 2024, so the plugin no longer has any function and maintaining it only ties up resources.
Relaunch SEO support is a low-cost consulting service tied directly to the firm's core shop relaunch projects and keeps its own dedicated page.
The SEO workshops are newly launched, cheap to offer using existing marketing expertise, and complement the firm's search marketing services.
